# Vendored libraries

Served from Harbor's own origin (no CDN) because they handle key material.

- `nacl-fast.min.js`: TweetNaCl.js 1.0.3 (https://github.com/dchest/tweetnacl-js),
  public domain (Unlicense). Used for X25519 key generation.
- `qrcode.js`: qrcode-generator 2.0.4 by Kazuhiko Arase
  (https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator), MIT license.
